//: Install settings: the environment variables an installation sets (compose override, .env, service file) for a feature to work. One entry per setting. `level`: required = the server does not do its job without it; expected = the server runs, but a feature shipped in `since` stays inert without it; optional = a default is fine, never warned about. `effect` says in one line what happens when it is missing. A deployment tool can read this file at any commit to check an installation before moving to it. test/settings.test.mjs fails if the server reads an environment variable that is not listed here.

settings.name: BOARD_KEY_PREFIX
settings.effect: Ticket keys use the default prefix ALV (a board from before 0.5.3 keeps SB).

settings.name: BOARD_JOB_ACTORS
settings.effect: No actor is treated as a background job.

settings.name: BOARD_DEFAULT_ROUTER
settings.effect: A comment of the owner with no @mention leaves the ticket in its lane: nothing is handed over.
